guide.title: The Guide
guide.intro: Not the cook. The one who tells you what the cook has been up to.
body: Pull up a stool. The cook here is Ritesh. He is in his final year of Data and AI Engineering at Turku University of Applied Sciences. He also works as a student assistant at Core Cognitive Tech, a research team inside the university.

He likes the part of machine learning that comes after the demo. Getting a model or a data pipeline to run every day without anyone babysitting it. His thesis predicts prices for used car parts from real listing data.

He speaks Finnish, English and Nepali, and he is learning Swedish. Outside the kitchen he plays football and just ran his first half marathon. Everything on the menu he built himself, so ask him about any of it.
